coach_now.label: Coach Me Now
coach_now.headline: Turn the latest Core 12 session into one focused coaching action.
coach_now.brief: Use the current movement evidence to choose a clear next step, explain why it matters, and stay inside education-only boundaries.
actions: Name the movement signal that matters most from the latest session.
Choose one technique or readiness adjustment for the next set.
Confirm what evidence is still missing before increasing intensity.
coach_now.reflection: After the action, compare how the movement felt, what changed, and what still needs another observation.

daily_boost.label: Daily Boost
daily_boost.headline: Convert today's readiness into a short movement-science boost.
daily_boost.brief: Keep the daily plan simple: one movement focus, one confidence cue, one recovery or preparation check.
actions: Pick one low-friction movement habit for today.
Use the latest readiness and confidence signals to scale the effort.
Record one observation that can improve the next Core 12 snapshot.
daily_boost.reflection: At the end of the day, note whether the boost improved confidence, consistency, or movement awareness.

Coach.label: Coach
Coach.brief: Direct cueing, plan adjustment, and athlete communication.
actions: Translate the Core signal into one coaching cue.
Select the next progression or regression based on control and confidence.
Coach.lens: Use short cues, observable movement language, and training-plan decisions.

Parent.label: Parent
Parent.brief: Supportive explanation, confidence, and safety boundaries.
actions: Explain the movement focus in plain language.
Watch for comfort, confidence, and whether professional help is needed.
Parent.lens: Keep the guidance calm, practical, and centered on learning and safe participation.

Student.label: Student
Student.brief: Learning vocabulary, observation skill, and portfolio growth.
actions: Write down the key term connected to the movement signal.
Connect the observation to a class concept or portfolio note.
Student.lens: Make the guidance educational, structured, and easy to study later.

Teacher.label: Teacher
Teacher.brief: Lesson framing, classroom milestones, and rubric-ready evidence.
actions: Turn the Core signal into one learning objective.
Ask students to document before-and-after observations.
Teacher.lens: Frame the output as instruction, assessment evidence, and responsible movement education.

Clinician.label: Clinician
Clinician.brief: Clear boundaries, observed data, and referral-aware communication.
actions: Separate observed movement facts from clinical conclusions.
Use the output to support education, referral awareness, or follow-up questions.
Clinician.lens: Keep the language precise, guarded, and explicit that the app is not diagnosing or treating.

Adult.label: Adult
Adult.brief: Practical consistency, readiness, and everyday movement decisions.
actions: Choose the smallest useful action that fits today.
Scale the effort to readiness instead of forcing a full session.
Adult.lens: Make the guidance usable immediately, with simple choices and clear limits.

auto.label: Auto (engine)
auto.brief: Balanced guidance selected from the current evidence.
actions: Let readiness, confidence, and risk signals decide how direct the message should be.
Keep the next action clear without overstating certainty.

supportive.label: Supportive
supportive.brief: Steady, reassuring guidance that builds confidence while staying accurate.
actions: Acknowledge what is working before naming the next adjustment.
Use one calm cue and one achievable next step.

encouraging.label: Encouraging
encouraging.brief: Positive momentum with short, confidence-forward coaching.
actions: Highlight progress from the latest session.
Give a simple challenge that still respects readiness.

motivating.label: Motivating
motivating.brief: Direct action language for users who want a stronger push.
actions: Call out the next action clearly.
Use the Core risk and confidence signals to keep intensity responsible.

gentleReset.label: Gentle Reset
gentleReset.brief: Low-pressure guidance for fatigue, uncertainty, or a reset day.
actions: Reduce the session to one controlled movement check.
Prioritize breathing, tempo, comfort, and honest observation.

guardrail: Education-only movement guidance. This output does not diagnose injury, prescribe treatment, or replace a qualified professional.
